bans.definition:
n a decree that prohibits something
n 100 bani equal 1 leu in Moldova
n 100 bani equal 1 leu in Romania
n an official prohibition or edict against something
n a bachelor's degree in nursing
v forbid the public distribution of ( a movie or a newspaper)
v prohibit especially by legal means or social pressure
v ban from a place of residence, as for punishment
v expel from a community or group

banshee.definition: n. (Irish folklore) a female spirit who wails to warn of impending death
banshee.translation: n. （爱尔兰和苏格兰传说中）预告死亡的女妖精

banshees.definition: n. (Irish folklore) a female spirit who wails to warn of impending death
banshees.translation: n. 女鬼( banshee的复数形式 )

banshie.definition:
n. A supernatural being supposed by the Irish and Scotch
   peasantry to warn a family of the speedy death of one of its members,
   by wailing or singing in a mournful voice under the windows of the
   house.
banshie.translation: n. （爱尔兰民俗中的）女妖精

bansko.translation: [地名] [保加利亚、马其顿] 班斯科
